name: inbetween
description: AI-directed 3D animation: Claude animates rigs with IK, previews, and validators.
author: Inbetween

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --current || echo "ffmpeg fetch skipped (video export will use ffmpeg from PATH)"
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs win32-x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
